title: RFQ submission
description: A demand record captured from a pay.sh catalog miss. Capture is deliberately frictionless: only the query and the buyer identity are required (DESIGN.md §2 — never tax the order book). This is the wire shape of POST /rfqs; the studio assigns id and created_at.

query.description: The failed catalog search — the demand signal itself.

monetization.description: How the buyer thinks the artifact should be monetized.

competition.description: Competing or adjacent offerings the buyer knows about.

buyer_npub.description: Buyer identity — the Nostr npub it will later pay with.

amount.description: Token amount in minor units of mint.
